notes.body:
Metoprolol whole-body model
Whole-body model of metoprolol and its metabolites alpha-hydroxymetoprolol and metoprolol acid with the blood circulation, the tissue distribution, the oral and intravenous dosing, the submodels of the liver (metabolism by CYP2D6 and other enzymes) and of the kidneys (renal excretion), and the reduction of the exercise heart rate by metoprolol.
The circulating species are whole blood concentrations: the blood flows transport the blood concentrations, the plasma concentration is the blood concentration over the blood to plasma ratio BP_<sid> (metoprolol 1.2, Regardh1974; the metabolites 1). The tissues exchange with the blood by the flow ftissue_<sid> towards the tissue/blood partition coefficient Kp_<sid>, which sets the volume of distribution (metoprolol about 4.5 l/kg of plasma, Regardh1974).
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

Metoprolol is absorbed completely: 95 % of an oral dose of 3H-metoprolol is recovered in the urine (Regardh1974).

The fraction of the controlled release form which is absorbed, relative to F_met: the drug released in the colon is absorbed less; the bioavailability relative to conventional tablets is 0.65 (0.42-0.94) (Sandberg1988).
The value of F_cr_met is the result of the fit PK_20261017_183259__fc82a, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

body.p: The activity score of the CYP2D6 diplotype over the one of *1/*1 (2): 0 for poor metabolizers, 1.5 for *1x2/*1. The genotype is set by the alleles of the CYP2D6 model (cyp2d6_allele1, cyp2d6_allele2, the indexes of the alleles) or by an activity score (cyp2d6_ac with both allele indexes -1).

10-26 µM in human liver microsomes (Ruedesheim2020, Madani1999, Yang2019, Kim1991); the saturation of the first pass is the dose dependent bioavailability (31 % after 20 mg, 46 % after 100 mg metoprolol tartrate, Johnsson1975). Not fitted, the data do not identify it (a flat profile likelihood between 2 and 100 µM).
About 15 % of the hepatic metabolism of extensive metabolizers is alpha-hydroxylation (about 10 % of an oral dose in the urine as alpha-hydroxymetoprolol, Lennard1982, Kirchheiner2004).
The value of LI__METOH_Vmax is the result of the fit PK_20261017_183259__fc82a, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: Vmax of the O-demethylation by CYP2D6 (*1/*1)

body.p: Together with the alpha-hydroxylation an intrinsic blood clearance of about 1.7 l/min at *1/*1 (CYP2D6 adds 20.9 l/hr of plasma clearance per active gene, Kirchheiner2004), a hepatic extraction of about 0.57 and a bioavailability of about 0.43.
The value of LI__ODM2D6_Vmax is the result of the fit PK_20261017_183259__fc82a, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

body.p: An intrinsic blood clearance of about 0.25 l/min, the clearance of poor metabolizers without the renal clearance (30.6 l/hr of plasma, Kirchheiner2004).
The value of LI__ODM_Vmax is the result of the fit PK_20261017_183259__fc82a, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

body.p: The GFR relative to the healthy GFR GFR_base (101 ml/min at 75 kg): a measured creatinine clearance of X ml/min is the renal function X/101. 1.0 is the normal renal function, below 1.0 an impaired one.

parameter.name: renal clearance of unbound metoprolol relative to the GFR

body.p: The renal clearance of metoprolol is METEX_f times the filtration of its unbound fraction, fup_met * GFR: 1 is filtration alone. 95-109 ml/min of plasma (Regardh1974).
The value of KI__METEX_f is the result of the fit PK_20261017_183259__fc82a, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
